headline: Where Liquidation Risk Relocates on Stellar

blocks.text: 1. Distress: Collateral health deteriorates during asset volatility.
2. Deterministic Inclusion: Predictable fees eliminate gas latency.
3. Absorption Bottleneck: $157,161,882 lending TVL liquidates against $1,238,140 AMM depth.

focal.reason: Exposes the core structural imbalance between protocol scale and on-chain market depth.
